_meta.source: NOAA CPC (ONI, RONI, weekly Niño 3.4); BoM Australia (relative Niño 3.4, Troup SOI)
_meta.notes: Five indices, each parsed from a machine-readable feed. NO global spread is published: the indices differ in region, baseline AND averaging window, so a min/max across all of them would be the exact error the panel warns against. Only pairs with a single free variable are comparable, and those are listed explicitly. A source that fails is omitted, never back-filled.

indices.label: ONI
indices.note: The index this page headlines. Absolute anomaly against a fixed base.

indices.label: RONI
indices.note: Subtracts the tropical-mean warming trend, so it reads lower than ONI as the tropics warm.

indices.label: Weekly Niño 3.4
indices.note: A single week, not a season. Runs hotter than the seasonal mean because it has not been averaged down.

indices.label: Relative Niño 3.4
indices.note: BoM's operational ocean index since Sept 2025, and it uses a higher threshold (+0.8) than CPC (+0.5) -- the same water clears a different bar.

indices.label: Troup SOI
indices.note: The ATMOSPHERE, not the ocean. Negative is El Niño-like. Shows the ocean signal is coupled rather than SST-only.

comparisons.free_variable: baseline: absolute, fixed 1991–2020 vs relative to the tropical mean
comparisons.reading: A like-for-like comparison. The whole gap is the choice of baseline -- removing the tropical-mean warming trend, nothing else.

comparisons.free_variable: window: JJA 2026, 3-month mean vs week ending 26 Aug 2026
comparisons.reading: NOT a disagreement. The gap is arithmetic: one number has been averaged down over a longer period and the other has not.

invalid_comparisons.why: 3 variables are free at once (agency: NOAA CPC vs BoM Australia; baseline: absolute, fixed 1991–2020 vs relative to the tropical mean; window: week ending 26 Aug 2026 vs week 24 Aug 2026 – 30 Aug 2026). Any gap between these two numbers is a mix of all of them, so it cannot be attributed to a cause and must not be read as agreement or disagreement.
